data: On which development set does cSMTiser+LM not reach 70% accuracy at 10k training data?

The question asks about the development set where cSMTiser+LM does not reach 70% accuracy at 10k training data. From the caption, we know that the x-axis is log-scaled, and the y-axis represents word accuracy. The lines represent different models: cSMTiser+LM (red), NMT-1 (green dashed), and NMT-2 (blue dotted). 

Looking at the graphs, we need to identify the one where cSMTiser+LM does not reach 70% accuracy at 10k training data. By examining the graphs, we can see that this occurs in the German (RIGIDES) dataset (b). In this graph, the red line (cSMTiser+LM) does not reach 70% accuracy at 10k training data. Therefore, the answer is the German (RIGIDES) development set.
